item.title: No. 7 Mizzou gymnastics secures highest-ranked win in program history
item.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) No. 7 Mizzou gymnastics was in control from start-to-finish in Friday night's historic upset over No. 2 Florida, toppling the Gators 197.200-196.500.
